description: This file defines the UserDecorator class in PHP, which provides methods to extend or decorate a User entity with additional functionality such as setting related Employee and UserRole entities, checking if the user is an admin, and managing non-hashed passwords.

classes.name: UserDecorator
classes.description: A decorator class for the User entity providing additional methods for managing related entities and user attributes.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the decorator with a User entity.

methods.name: getUser
methods.description: Protected method to access the underlying User entity.

methods.name: setEmployeeByEmpNumber
methods.description: Associates the User with an Employee entity based on employee number.

methods.name: setUserRoleById
methods.description: Associates the User with a UserRole entity by role ID.

methods.name: isAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the User's role name is 'Admin'.

methods.name: getNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Retrieves the non-hashed password temporarily stored in the decorator.

methods.name: setNonHashedPassword
methods.description: Sets the non-hashed password in the decorator.
